mapper.sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY bmt12_person_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8") AS bmt12_pc_history_id , t.* FROM ( SELECT f_emp_kor_nm(bmt11_person_id) AS bmt12_person_nm , bmt11_messenger AS bmt12_messenger , bmt11_website AS bmt12_website , ast01_class_tree_nm AS bmt12_ast_class_tree_nm , bmt10_spec AS bmt12_spec , bmt12_internal_ip , bmt12_etc FROM bmt10_info INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = bmt10_ast_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN bmt11_history ON ( bmt11_info_id = bmt10_info_id AND bmt11_start_date = (SELECT MAX(bmt11_start_date) FROM bmt11_history WHERE bmt11_info_id = bmt10_info_id AND bmt11_start_date <= #{stdDate}) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN bmt12_pc_history ON ( bmt12_info_id = bmt10_info_id AND bmt12_start_date = (SELECT MAX(bmt12_start_date) FROM bmt12_pc_history WHERE bmt12_info_id = bmt10_info_id AND bmt12_start_date <= #{stdDate}) ) WHERE bmt10_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast01_item_s_class_cd IN ( SELECT sys09_code FROM sys13_code_group INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_id = sys13_code_id WHERE sys13_kind_group_cd = 'ItemSClassCode006' ) AND COALESCE(bmt10_retire_date,'9999-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) t WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(bmt12_person_nm, bmt12_messenger, bmt12_website, bmt12_internal_ip ,bmt12_ast_class_tree_nm, bmt12_spec, bmt12_etc)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
mapper.select: SELECT q.bmt12_pc_history_id AS pc_history_id , q.bmt12_person_nm AS person_name , q.bmt12_messenger AS messenger , q.bmt12_website AS website , q.bmt12_internal_ip AS internal_ip , q.bmt12_ast_class_tree_nm AS ast_class_tree_name , q.bmt12_spec AS spec , q.bmt12_etc AS etc FROM () q
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_long01, sys99_string01, sys99_text01, sys99_text02, sys99_string02, sys99_string03 , sys99_text03, sys99_text04 ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{printPersonId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , q.bmt12_pc_history_id, q.bmt12_person_nm, q.bmt12_messenger, q.bmt12_website, q.bmt12_internal_ip, q.bmt12_ast_class_tree_nm , q.bmt12_spec, q.bmt12_etc FROM () q
